text: Control Engineering is an engineering application branch of the discipline of control Science and Engineering, focusing on "how to transform control theory into the regulation and control techniques of actual systems". Its essence is to solve the "precise control" problem of various dynamic systems through mathematical modeling, algorithm design and hardware implementation - from the temperature regulation of smart homes to the attitude control of space rockets, the core goal is to make complex systems operate stably as expected. For instance, the Battery Management system (BMS) of Tesla electric vehicles balances the charging and discharging of each battery cell through control algorithms to ensure both range and safety. This is a typical application of control engineering in the field of new energy.
